+install_bat() {
+	if false; then
+		DL=$(
+			curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" -H "${CURL_AUTH}" https://api.github.com/repos/sharkdp/bat/releases/latest |

+		)
+	fi
+}
